ewa.title: Earned Wage Access, done the right way
ewa.description: After the 15th of every month, employees can draw down a share of the wages they've already earned — directly from the GajiPay app, reconciled automatically at payday. No interest. No lending licence required. No debt created.

about.metaDescription: GajiPay is building the compliance and financial wellness platform Malaysian SMEs have had to stitch together themselves — company secretary, payroll, HR and Earned Wage Access, in one place.
about.title: The back office Malaysian SMEs have had to stitch together themselves
about.description: GajiPay Sdn Bhd exists because 97% of Malaysian businesses are MSMEs, and almost none of them can afford — or want — five separate vendors for payroll, HR, compliance and financial wellness.
intro: Most SMEs run payroll through one tool, HR through a spreadsheet, a company secretary through a retainer they barely think about, and — if their employees are lucky — a bolted-on salary-advance app from a fourth provider entirely. None of these systems talk to each other, and none of them were built around the reality of Malaysian statutory compliance.

GajiPay starts from the compliance every Sdn Bhd already needs — a company secretary, correct EPF/SOCSO/EIS/PCB payroll — and builds outward from there. Once payroll and attendance data lives in one place, we can do something no bolted-on app can: calculate exactly how much of an employee's wage has actually been earned, in real time, and let them access it early, fairly, and without debt.
about.valuesTitle: Three things we won't compromise on

values.title: Compliance first, always
values.description: We start with what Malaysian law actually requires — a company secretary, correct statutory payroll — before we build anything that touches money.

values.title: Built for Malaysia specifically
values.description: Not a regional template with local logos swapped in. EPF, SOCSO, EIS, PCB and the Employment Act are the foundation, not an add-on.

values.title: No debt, ever
values.description: Advance Pay only ever releases wages already earned. We are not a lender, we don't hold a moneylending licence, and we never will pretend otherwise.
